# PYACC tables (generated by make_tables.py)

Values: largest error in ulps under the rules of Gladman et al. (3 significant digits rounded up; an input where only one of the library result and the exact result is NaN gives Inf). In parentheses, when different: the largest error excluding results affected by a flush-to-zero/denormals-are-zero mode of the backend and NaN mismatches. 0.500 = correctly rounded on all inputs; -- = function not provided for this format/backend; marks: f = some results flushed by the backend's FTZ/DAZ mode, n = spurious NaN for some inputs, m = NaN missing (number returned where the result is NaN).
